The attorney general has asked for a written response and remediation plan regarding possible overcharges on consumer accounts. Our current draft states we found no violation, proposes no restitution, and does not include a customer-notice plan. Before I sign off on this package, I need each of you to share any case-specific findings or requirements from your areas. Let's start with regulatory, then client-relations, then privacy. Please go ahead.
